title: The Pokémon That Needs 999 Coins to Evolve

direction.premise: Pokédex #999 has an evolution mechanic built around the same number: collect 999 Gimmighoul Coins, then level it up.
direction.audiencePromise: Reveal why Gimmighoul is #999, make the coin mechanic visually satisfying, then pay it off by landing on Pokémon #1000.
direction.openLoop: Why does Pokémon #999 need exactly 999 coins?
direction.payoff: The 999-coin requirement turns Gimmighoul into Gholdengo, Pokédex #1000.
direction.engagementQuestion: Is 999 coins a brilliant evolution gimmick or just too much work?

voice.instructions: Fast, playful, curious short-form narrator. Sound like a knowledgeable Pokémon fan sharing a bizarre mechanic with a friend. Punch the words 999 and 1000. Keep the delivery energetic but natural, with tiny pauses before each reveal. Never imitate a known person or character.

scenes.headline: 999 COINS. ONE EVOLUTION.
scenes.narration: This tiny Pokémon needs nine hundred ninety-nine coins to evolve.
scenes.caption: 999 COINS TO EVOLVE

scenes.headline: A GHOST IN A TREASURE CHEST
scenes.narration: Meet Gimmighoul, Ghost-type Pokémon number nine hundred ninety-nine, hiding inside a treasure chest.
scenes.caption: A GHOST. IN A CHEST.

scenes.headline: NO STONE. NO TRADE.
scenes.narration: There is no evolution stone, trade, or fixed evolution level.
scenes.caption: NO STONE • NO TRADE

scenes.headline: COLLECT 999 GIMMIGHOUL COINS
scenes.narration: You collect Gimmighoul Coins until the counter hits nine hundred ninety-nine. Then level Gimmighoul up once.

scenes.headline: #999 BECOMES #1000
scenes.narration: And that turns Pokémon nine hundred ninety-nine into Gholdengo, Pokémon number one thousand.

scenes.headline: BRILLIANT OR TOO MUCH?
scenes.narration: Brilliant evolution gimmick—or way too much work?
scenes.caption: BRILLIANT OR RIDICULOUS?
